summary: Loma Negra filed a 6-K disclosing board approval of an offer letter to supply concrete and complementary services to SACDE, a related party under Argentina's Capital Markets Law, for the Bahía Blanca granular urea plant over 30 months. The contract exceeds 1% of corporate net worth (based on Dec 31, 2025 financials), triggering related-party review; the Audit Committee issued a favorable arm's-length opinion and the board resolved unanimously. This is an ordinary supply agreement, not a special situation; watch for any related-party governance challenge or margin disclosure.
